name: Vala’s Magic
body:
You have access to your mystery’s unique spells.

Prerequisites: Valkyrie with the vala archetype, Cha 14, 4th level character.

Benefit: You add the 1st-4th level spells from your chosen mystery to your known spell list. These cannot be exchanged for different spells at higher levels.
